title: Pure Magical Musket
summary: Magical Musket cards only, with staples and an automatic Extra Deck. Magical Musketeers are LIGHT Fiends that let you activate Magical Musket Spells and Traps from the hand on either turn. Each one also triggers when a Spell/Trap is activated in its column. Magical Musketeer Caspar searches a Magical Musket card, Starfire summons a small Musketeer from the Deck, Kidbrave discards one to draw two, and Doc recovers one from the GY. The Spells and Traps are the deck's interaction: Desperado destroys a face-up card, Cross-Domination negates a monster, Last Stand negates a Spell/Trap, and Dancing Needle banishes from the GYs. Magical Musket - Crooked Crown, the newest Main Deck card, summons a Musketeer on either Main Phase and locks the opponent's zone across from it. Magical Musketeer Max searches several Magical Musket Spells/Traps, one per monster they control. Magical Musket Mastermind Caspar is not released in the TCG.
